"AMPS" |homeworld= |birth= |death= |creator= |manufacturer=[[Veril Line Systems]]{{BuildR2Cite|6|Droid Directory}} |line= |model=[[EGL power droid]]{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Droid in Star Wars|video=UQg6aX7lqTA|nolive=1}} |class=[[Power droid]]''[[Rey's Survival Guide]]'' |cost= |length= |width= |height= |mass= |gender= |pronouns=He/him |sensor= |plating=[[Color|Gray]]{{Film|VII}} |armament= |equipment= |affiliation= }} {{Quote|If I need welding, I see a manumitted power droid named AMPS.|Rey writes about EGL-21 in her survival guide|}} '''EGL-21''', also known as "'''AMPS'''" or "'''Amps'''," was a [[Manumission|manumitted]] [[EGL power droid]] based in [[Niima Outpost]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Jakku]]. He welded objects for [[scavenger]]s in exchange for power, spare [[gas]] canisters, interesting metals, or a good joke. The [[droid]] and his mechanical colleague [[GTAW-74]] could sometimes be spotted in the shade trading jokes that their customers had brought them. The scavenger [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] often spent [[time]] thinking up jokes to trade with EGL-21 for his services. ==Biography== {{Quote|AMPS doesn't eat rations, of course, but he'll weld in exchange for a recharge, spare gas canisters, metals he finds interesting, or a good joke. I spend a lot of time driving across the Goazon trying to think of jokes AMPS will decide are worth a trade.|Rey, writing in her survival guide|}} [[File:Amps_in_Niima.jpg|thumb|left|200px|EGL-21 in Niima Outpost]] EGL-21 was the designation of an [[EGL power droid]] manufactured by [[Veril Line Systems]] who was also known by the nicknames "AMPS" or "Amps."{{Databank|egl-21-amps-power-droid|EGL-21 "Amps" Power Droid}} By the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VII}} to [[34 ABY]]. As the final entries in ''[[Rey's Survival Guide]]'' describe events from the film, earlier entries in the journal, including the mention of EGL-21, must have been written no later than 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]]. he was [[Manumission|manumitted]] and based on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Jakku]] in [[Niima Outpost]], a [[Merchant|trading]] center controlled by the [[junk dealer]] [[Unkar Plutt]]. There, the [[droid]] would offer his services as a welder to [[scavenger]]s in exchange for a recharge, spare [[gas]] canisters, interesting metals, or a good joke, as the [[Ration pack|ration portions]] that most of the scavengers traded in were useless to him. [[File:EGL-21_sketch.jpg|thumb|right|100px|Rey's sketch of EGL-21]] The [[welding droid]] [[GTAW-74]] was a colleague of EGL-21, and the pair could sometimes be spotted together in the shade trading jokes that their customers had brought to them. The scavenger [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] sometimes traded with EGL-21 and would try and think of jokes he might like while she was traveling across the [[Goazon Badlands]]. Whenever she did think of a new joke she would seek EGL-21 and GTAW-74 out, as the pair's services could greatly improved the value of pieces of scrap. At some point, she wrote about the [[power droid]] in a [[Rey's survival guide|survival guide]] she was compiling and included a drawing of him. In 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]], EGL-21 walked through one of the [[tent]]s in Niima Outpost and passed by Rey and the [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] arguing with the former [[First Order stormtrooper]] [[Finn]]. Soon after, the [[First Order]] [[Escape from Jakku|attacked]] Niima Outpost. ==Characteristics== EGL-21 was a power droid who enjoyed a good joke. He became so quirky with age and lack of [[memory wipe]]s that he formed a genuine friendship with the equally eccentric GTAW-74. Simple survival and the company of others was enough for the pair. He had [[Color|gray]] plating and the capability to weld objects. ==Behind the scenes== EGL-21 was created for the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. He was not identified in the film but was simultaneously named through the books ''[[Rey's Survival Guide]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which were released in conjunction with the film and written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]], respectively.''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of EGL-21}} *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Rey's Survival Guide]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|EGL-21|''[[Rey's Survival Guide]]''}} *{{BuildR2Cite|6|Droid Directory}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Droid in Star Wars|video=UQg6aX7lqTA|nolive=1}} *''[[Star Wars: These Are the Droids You're Looking For]]'' *{{Databank|egl-21-amps-power-droid|EGL-21 "Amps" Power Droid}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=EGL-21 |fr=EGL-21 |ja=EGL-21 |nl=EGL-21 }} [[Category:Droids with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:EGL power droids]]
